=== about
A model answer in three regions: the container, closed blocks appended to the done region, the open block replaced in the tail, one outer patch at the end with data-ypy-answer done.
=== page
<div id="chat"></div>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #chat
data: elements <article id="a1" ypy-untrusted ypy-follow ypy-announce-start="Answer started" ypy-announce="Answer ready" ypy-announce-stop="Stopped" ypy-announce-error="Failed" aria-live="off" aria-busy="true"><div id="a1-done"></div><div id="a1-tail"></div></article>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #a1-tail
data: elements <p>Hello **wor</p>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #a1-done
data: elements <p>Hello <strong>world</strong>.</p>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #a1-tail
data: elements <p>Second</p>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #a1-tail
data: elements <p>Second para</p>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: selector #a1
data: elements <article id="a1" ypy-untrusted ypy-follow ypy-announce-start="Answer started" ypy-announce="Answer ready" ypy-announce-stop="Stopped" ypy-announce-error="Failed" aria-live="off" data-ypy-answer="done"><p>Hello <strong>world</strong>.</p><p>Second para</p></article>

=== dom
